sunset.subject: the same sunset
sunset.subline: All from one evening. You kept every single frame.

tulips.subject: the same tulip field
tulips.subline: The field did not move between shots.

canal.subject: the same canal house
canal.subline: The same house, from four steps apart.

latte.subject: the same coffee
latte.subline: The foam was slightly different each time.

dinner.subject: a plate of dinner
dinner.subline: It went cold while you found the angle.

concert.subject: one blurry concert
concert.subline: Blurry, all of them. You were there anyway.

beach.subject: the same stretch of beach
beach.subline: Same sea, same sand, forty-eight times.

cat.subject: the cat, not moving
cat.subline: She had not moved since the last one.

bike.subject: your bike, where you left it
bike.subline: In case you forgot where you parked it.

church.subject: the same church tower
church.subline: You will never look at these again.

windmill.subject: the same windmill
windmill.subline: It turns. You did not need this many.

dog.subject: the dog, not moving
dog.subline: He was not going anywhere. You made sure.
